notes: Lead with the investment lens: fragmentation and unmet service quality create the opening, not just market growth. Point to the phrase buy-and-build and explain that the deck proves where scale economics appear by corridor and hub type. Expect the question: why private equity wins here versus strategic buyers or infrastructure funds.
title: India’s fragmented cold-chain logistics gap creates a scalable buy-and-build opportunity for private equity
subtitle: Investment case for a PE committee showing how structural demand growth, underbuilt integrated capacity, and corridor-specific hub economics support entry through a flagship hub plus roll-up of regional operators
